notes.title: Message Quest Universe - Part 1
notes.content:
During the development we made up lots of lore for Message Quest Universe and our future games. We didn't put it in the game, but still want to share with you some pieces. Do you like the format?  

[img]http://i.imgur.com/vBeC5Yy.png[/img]

Also we're doing some research about the most unique and original fictional Universes in games and other media. If you want to participate, please share with us - what the most fantastic universes you remember? 

That's some from our TOP-list:
- Dune 
- Saga (the comics)
- Gormenghast 

What's your TOP?

notes.title: Fun Facts about Message Quest
notes.content:
What would you like to know about Message Quest? 

For a start, we’d like to share some Message Quest facts. 

[h1]Fact 1 - Feste's name[/h1]
Feste is named after a jester from Shakespeare’s "Twelfth Night". This is our favourite Shakespeare's comedy. 

[h1]Fact 2 - A bit about sales[/h1]
For now we've sold about 1 000 copies - wow! 
The most copies are sold in Russia, the United States and Germany. 
The total number of activations is about 3 000! 
The most players are in the United States, Germany and Japan. 

[h1]Fact 3  - Noah's gender[/h1]
Yep, Noah is a boy. We know that some people can be disappointed. But he is really young. In fact, younger than Feste. Who could imagine, right? 

[h1]Fact 4 - Achievments[/h1]
Almost 30% of all players have all the achievements. 
And only 14% have been able to resist the infamous Glowing bottle. Keep trying! 

[h1]Fact 5 - Voicovers' language[/h1]
All of our characters (except the refugee girl) use Lodgespeak - the language of Ice-Pick Lodge studio which was created for their game "Knock-Knock". With their kind permission we’ve used it in our game as well. Should we perhaps develop it into a real fantasy language? Limbokoroteda! Egerekefara.


Want to know something else? If it's not a spoiler for our next game – we’ll be glad to answer!

notes.title: Message Quest Updates + Polish localization!
notes.content:
Hello!

Sorry for so early updates, but:

1. We add Polish localization - thanks to Kamil Tajs!

2. We fixed some problems which bother you, guys. So now there must be a bit less mistakes ;)

If there are any troubles - please, share with us. We are here for you all the time!

Enjoy the game! Thank you!
